glosses: English or American pound avoirdupois (a unit of mass equivalent to 453.6 g)
libra, Spanish pound (a traditional unit of mass equivalent to about 460 g)
British pound (the currency of the United Kingdom and its dependencies, originally notionally equivalent to a pound of stirling silver)

examples.en: How much for half a kilo?

examples.text: Parece que has perdido unas cuantas libras.
examples.en: It looks like you've lost a few pounds.
We bought a pound of tea.

examples.text: Las reparaciones costarán al menos veinte libras.
examples.en: The repairs will cost at least 20 pounds.

examples.text: Eran aproximadamente 25 centavos por libra más baratos.
examples.en: They were about 25 cents a pound cheaper.
